A note on privacy

Files are read in memory, never sent to a server or stored by this app. Refreshing clears the session.

What do we check?

Missing SKUs and titles, duplicate SKUs (case-insensitive), invalid prices, invalid stock, whitespace, identical rows, self-parent links and duplicate parent/variant combinations.

Score = percentage of rows with no findings. It is a rule-based check, not a marketplace certification. Parent rows do not need to be included. No price or product claims are verified.
